### 🍄 Nom Científic i Vernacular / Scientific & Catalan Names
- **Scientific Name**: [e.g. *Leccinellum lepidum*]
- **Catalan Name(s)**: [e.g. *Alzinenc*, *Molleric d'alzina*]
- **Spanish Name**: [e.g. *Boleto de encina*]
- **English Name**: [e.g. *Holm Oak Bolete*]

### 🍽️ Comestibilitat / Edibility
- [ ] Excel·lent comestible (Choice edible)
- [ ] Bon comestible (Good edible)
- [ ] Comestible mediocri (Mediocre edible)
- [ ] Sense valor culinari (Inedible / No culinary value)
- [ ] Tòxic (Toxic / Gastrotoxic)
- [ ] MORTAL (Deadly poisonous)

### 🌲 Hàbitat i Època / Habitat & Seasonality
- **Trees & Soil**: [e.g. Holm oak (*Quercus ilex*), Mediterranean garrigues, limestone or acidic soil]
- **Fruiting Months**: [e.g. October, November, December, January]
- **Altitude Range**: [e.g. 100m – 1000m]
- **Catalan Foraging Zones**: [e.g. Litoral i Prelitoral, Serralada Sud i Prades]

### ⚠️ Possibles Confusions / Lookalikes & Safety
- **Lookalike Species**: [e.g. *Caloboletus calopus*, *Rubroboletus satanas*]
- **Key Diagnostic Traits**: [e.g. Yellow pores, grey-violet bruising on stem cut, lack of red color on stem or pores]
